Household Type

Household Type
Household Type Description
1
Youthful Married PNI
PNI < 21 and Marital Status = Married/Domestic Partner Widow(er) (ignore the relationship of any other driver in the household)
2
Youthful Single PNI
If household is not Group 1, and PNI < 21 and PNI Marital Status = Single (ignore the relationship of any other driver in the household)
3
Child in Household
If household is not Group 1 or 2 and if any rated driver is a Child 2 of the PNI, has an age < 25 and is single.
4
Senior in Household
If household is not Group 1, 2 or 3 and if any rated driver who is not the PNI or Spouse 1 age > 64
5
Senior PNI Household
If household is not Group 1, 2, 3 or 4 and either PNI or Spouse 1 age > 64
6
Married Household
If household is not Group 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 and marital status of all rated drivers in household = Married/Widow(er)/Domestic Partner
7
Single Household
If household is not Group 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 and marital status of all rated drivers in household = Single
8
Other Household
If household is not Group 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 or 7
